name: German

requirementGroups.sourceQuote: FOUNDATION COURSES (fulfills upper level writing): CLTR 200: Topics in Critical Thinking; CLTR 389: MLC Research Seminar

requirementGroups.sourceQuote: CORE COURSES: GRMN 151: Intermediate German I; GRMN 152: Intermediate German II; GRMN 200: Advanced Conversation and Composition; GRMN 202: Introduction to German Cultural Studies; GRMN 203: Introduction to German Literature; GRMN 256: Advanced Topics in German Studies

requirementGroups.label: Upper-level German electives (3)
requirementGroups.sourceQuote: ELECTIVE COURSES: Three upper-level elective courses in German literature and culture
